title: A file manager does not open .acre files in acre-gui
body: `acre-gui` has app menu entries in `~/.local/share/applications`. No MIME type covers `.acre` files, so a file manager does not offer `acre-gui` for them. A fix needs a shared-mime-info XML file that maps `*.acre` to a type such as `text/x-acre`, and a `MimeType=` line on both desktop entries.
close_reason: Set up on Jack's desktop on 2026-11-24, outside the repo: a shared-mime-info package `acre.xml` in `~/.local/share/mime/packages` maps `*.acre` to `text/x-acre` (a subclass of text/plain), both app menu entries gained `MimeType=text/x-acre;`, and `xdg-mime default` makes the release entry the default. GIO reports `.acre` files as `text/x-acre`. The repo ships no desktop entries, so nothing here is versioned.
